tools.name: market_pulse
tools.description: FREE. Snapshot of the top coins' perpetual futures: price, 24h change, funding rate (+APR), open interest; plus the top 3 24h movers among liquid perps.

tools.name: perp_scanner
tools.description: PRO. Full scanner across all USDT perpetuals: sort by change, volume, funding or open interest; filter by min 24h volume.

tools.name: funding_extremes
tools.description: PRO. Most positive and most negative funding rates across liquid perps (crowded longs/shorts), with annualised APR.

tools.name: big_moves
tools.description: PRO. Alert list: liquid perps that moved more than a threshold (default 10%) in 24h, with funding context.
